title: Sparkling Tater
description: A unique and surprisingly delicious dish featuring potatoes, onions, peppers, and bacon slow-cooked in a Dutch oven with Sprite.
steps: Chop the potatoes and soak them for about an hour.
Place the soaked potatoes into a Dutch oven.
Chop the onion, green pepper, and serrano pepper.
Cook the onions and peppers together, seasoning with salt and pepper.
Mix the cooked vegetables into the Dutch oven with the potatoes.
Add the bacon to the Dutch oven.
Pour enough Sprite into the Dutch oven to cover everything.
Bake in the Dutch oven for one hour.
notes:
The dish has a unique sweetness from the Sprite and the onions cook down to a very pleasant texture.
